name: Law Offices of Michael Cordova
about: Law Offices of Michael Cordova is a personal injury firm with a single office in Phoenix.
The firm states that it works on a contingency fee, with nothing to pay unless the case is won; the first consultation is free. It publishes material in English and Spanish.

google.source: Google Business Profile via Places API. 1 listing, counts summed and rating weighted by count

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

json_ld_descriptions: At the Law Offices of Michael Cordova, we are experienced attorneys who obtain outstanding results for our clients. We have been in business since 1994 and have since then helped our clients secure the outcomes they deserve, including many millions of dollars in settlements and verdicts. We provide professional and quality legal advice you expect from a great law firm. We are committed to each of our clients and provide personal attention to our clients. Our team of experienced lawyers are accessible and responsive to the needs and concerns of each of our clients.
